rows.notes: Both the V2 RPCs the 1.6.2 client uses by default (SandboxCreateV2, router stdio, x-modal-auth-token) and the V1 set are served. A Sandbox is a Cua Space started from the layer checkpoint of its Image; the entrypoint is the Image ENTRYPOINT/CMD or the command given.

rows.area: Sandbox: exec and ContainerProcess, StreamReader, StreamWriter
rows.notes: The command router (TaskCommandRouter) is served with Modal's JWT flow: exec start/wait/poll, stdout/stderr by offset (idempotent re-reads), stdin by offset (exactly once), PTY. Output keeps the last 64 MiB per descriptor. A missing executable exits 127 (derived guess).

rows.area: Sandbox: lifecycle, lookup, tags, listing, naming
rows.notes: timeout ends the Sandbox with exit code 124 (SandboxTimeoutError from wait); idle_timeout ends it after that long without exec or stdio activity; terminate exits 137. Names are unique per App among running Sandboxes (AlreadyExistsError).

rows.area: Sandbox: tunnels, ports, readiness and connect tokens
rows.notes: encrypted_ports are `<port>-<sandbox id>.<domain>` names on the gateway's TLS router (the generated CA is in SSL_CERT_FILE); unencrypted_ports are loopback listeners. A connect token authorizes requests (Authorization: Bearer) to its port; the router adds X-Verified-User-Data. h2_ports offer h2 in ALPN on their names (and http/1.1 only elsewhere).

rows.area: Sandbox: filesystem snapshots and exit snapshots
rows.notes: A Cua checkpoint of the Space, registered as an Image; Sandboxes created from it fork the checkpoint (files kept; the snapshotted machine's processes continue in the copy, unlike Modal's fresh boot: differences #5). enable_exit_snapshot takes one when the Sandbox ends. INTERIM: moves to the core snapshot store; not extended meanwhile.

rows.area: Sandbox: directory snapshots and image mounts
rows.notes: snapshot_directory is a tar of the directory (stored in the gateway) registered as an Image; mount_image bind-mounts it read-only at the path, unmount_image removes it. The behaviour needs a real guest, so it is verified on a Mac test host. INTERIM: moves to the core snapshot store; not extended meanwhile.

A Cua checkpoint with memory (suspend-and-attach); restoring starts a fork with the processes of the snapshot. Requires `_experimental_enable_snapshot=True` at create, as in Modal. INTERIM: moves to the core power states + snapshot store; not extended meanwhile.
logs.fetch/tail/stream read the entrypoint's output with timestamps. reload_volumes pushes the Sandbox's changes and pulls what others committed.

The client runs Modal's guest-side fs tool as an exec; the gateway answers those execs (read, write, list, mkdir, rm, stat, watch) through cua-spacesd with the tool's JSON stderr errors, so each failure maps to its SandboxFilesystem*Error. Reads above 1 GiB raise FileTooLarge.

UnimplementedError (TaskContainerCreate / SandboxContainerCreateV2): a Space is one machine; a second container sharing its network namespace is a Modal runtime feature. Run the second process in the same Space with Sandbox.exec, or start another Sandbox.

UnimplementedError: Cua Spaces have no host-enforced egress filtering beyond block-all (block_network=True) or open. A policy that code running as root in the Space could undo would be a fake. INTERIM: moves to the core Space Policy / network policy (native errors until it exists); not extended meanwhile.

Each layer is built in a Space from its parent's checkpoint (FROM ghcr.io/trycua/*, images.json entries, python:X through uv, ubuntu/debian, micromamba, scratch; another base raises ImageBuildError naming how to map it) and cached by a hash of the whole spec. COPY/ADD take the context files and mounts; `COPY --from=ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv` and add_python's python-build-standalone mount are recognised and installed with uv. `run_function` runs the Function in a Function container of the parent layer and keeps the container's disk as the layer. Hermetic runs log the build commands (CUA_MODAL_BUILD_DRY_RUN); real builds are in the a real-Space test host lane. INTERIM: moves to the core image build service; not extended meanwhile.

publish names an Image in the gateway; from_name resolves it (NotFoundError when unpublished). Image.logs reads each layer's build output through ImageBuildChainGet and the logs RPCs; the output of a gateway that restarted is gone. INTERIM: moves to the core image build service; not extended meanwhile.

ImageBuildError/UnimplementedError. A private registry base must run on Cua Spaces, which need cua-spacesd in the image, so the base is mapped (images.json) rather than pulled. INTERIM: moves to the core image build service; not extended meanwhile.

A Volume is a folder of Cua Volume (`modal-volumes/<store>/`); uploads and downloads go through the gateway's block endpoints (protocol version 1). Mounting copies the volume into the Sandbox (read_only and sub_path honoured); its changes are pushed back every 3 s and when it ends, and reload_volumes pulls what others committed (Modal v1's model; Cua Volume is guarded per Space, so a Space cannot bind it). Ownership and modes are not stored. Version 2 volumes raise InvalidError (the v2 block protocol is not served). INTERIM: moves to the core volumes system; not extended meanwhile.

AWS Mountpoint for S3 installed in the Space on demand (S3, and R2/GCS through their S3-compatible endpoints, with the secret's keys; anonymous without a secret; key_prefix, read_only, requester_pays honoured). oidc_auth_role_arn needs Modal's OIDC provider and raises UnimplementedError. Needs network in the Space. INTERIM: moves to the core volumes system; not extended meanwhile.

Named secrets are stored in the gateway state (0600); a Sandbox, Function or Image build gets them as environment variables (the image's environment first, the secret over it, `env=` last). INTERIM: moves to the core egress gateway + secrets broker; not extended meanwhile.
Persisted in the gateway; values are Modal's pickled bytes, opaque to the gateway. Ephemeral Dicts are removed when their client stops heartbeating.
Persisted FIFO partitions with blocking gets (a get waits for a put, up to the timeout, then raises queue.Empty); partition keys up to 64 bytes.
Apps are looked up or created by name, tagged and deployed (published with their Functions and Classes). An ephemeral App ends with its Sandboxes when its client stops heartbeating (90 s grace).
UnimplementedError: modal.Server routes inbound HTTP to containers through Modal's edge; expose a port of a Sandbox with encrypted_ports.
Token pairs are `ak-<hash>` / the gateway key (MODAL_TOKEN_ID/SECRET from `cua compat env --provider modal`); anything else is AuthError.
from_oauth_credentials exchanges a refresh token with Modal's identity provider, not the gateway; the gateway does not name an input-plane URL, so Functions use the control-plane call protocol.
Environments are namespaces for objects (create, list, delete, rename).

Workspace.from_context/hydrate/name work (the workspace is the gateway's). Members, roles, service users, proxy tokens, settings and billing are Modal organisation features: UnimplementedError naming the RPC; access to Cua Spaces is the Cua account's.

Containers are Cua Spaces started from the Function's Image plus the modal client (a cached layer), running Modal's own container entrypoint; the gateway queues calls and inputs, scales containers (max_containers, min_containers, scaledown_window), retries by the Function's policy and ends inputs past their timeout. The hermetic suite runs the real entrypoint as a host process (test only); a real-Space test host runs it in a Space.

Batching and input concurrency are the container's (Modal's entrypoint); the gateway delivers up to batch_max_size inputs per FunctionGetInputs. timeout is enforced by the container and, as a backstop, by the gateway (FunctionTimeoutError); retries follow the Retries policy with its backoff.

UnimplementedError (FunctionGetMetrics, FunctionGetTimeRangeStats, MetricsGetInfo): utilization and request-count time series are Modal's observability product. get_current_stats() (backlog, running inputs) is served.
A call's inputs and outputs are kept in the gateway until it restarts. cancel marks the inputs and tells the container (with terminate_containers, stops it).
Parametrised classes bind their parameters (FunctionBindParams); enter/exit hooks run in the container.

UnimplementedError naming the feature when the Function is created: web endpoints need Modal's public edge (expose a port of a Sandbox instead), schedules are Modal's scheduler (use a Cua routine), clusters and flash are multi-node products, GPUs need the cua.gpu option (below). forward/interact are container-only client calls; sessioned and SchedulerPlacement are accepted by the client and carry no behaviour here.
Server-side retries with initial_delay, backoff_coefficient and max_delay.
These act inside a Function container on the entrypoint's own state; the gateway sees only the resulting FunctionGetInputs/FunctionGetDynamicConcurrency calls.
UnimplementedError (SharedVolume*): Modal deprecated NetworkFileSystem in favour of Volume.
UnimplementedError (ProxyGet): Modal Proxies are a Modal networking product (static outbound IPs).
Client-side ignore patterns for add_local_dir; the gateway receives the resulting files.

Each gRPC code maps as Modal's client maps it (NOT_FOUND to NotFoundError, ALREADY_EXISTS, INVALID_ARGUMENT, FAILED_PRECONDITION/ABORTED to ConflictError, UNIMPLEMENTED, UNAUTHENTICATED to AuthError); a cancelled input is a RemoteError, and the Function and Sandbox results map to FunctionTimeoutError, SandboxTimeoutError, SandboxTerminatedError and the SandboxFilesystem* classes.

rows.area: Exceptions raised by the client only
rows.notes: Raised by the SDK itself (transport, serialization, deprecations, client-side validation, a detached Sandbox, an exec timeout it enforces, InputCancellation raised inside a container) or for gateway answers the suites do not provoke (output expiry: outputs are kept until the gateway ends; quota and spend errors have no gateway equivalent). They carry no gateway behaviour.

create_params.name: app
create_params.notes: The App the Sandbox belongs to (looked up or created by name).

create_params.name: name
create_params.notes: Unique among running Sandboxes of the App.

create_params.name: tags
create_params.notes: Listable by tag.

create_params.name: image
create_params.notes: The layer checkpoint the Space starts from.

create_params.name: env
create_params.notes: Environment variables of the entrypoint and execs.

create_params.name: secrets
create_params.notes: Secrets as environment variables.

create_params.name: network_file_systems
create_params.notes: UnimplementedError: use a Volume.

create_params.name: timeout
create_params.notes: Seconds; the Sandbox ends with exit code 124. At most 24 hours.

create_params.name: idle_timeout
create_params.notes: Ends the Sandbox after that long without exec or stdio activity.

create_params.name: workdir
create_params.notes: Absolute path, created if missing; the entrypoint and execs start there.

create_params.name: gpu
create_params.notes: A Modal GPU model is refused (UnimplementedError) unless experimental_options sets cua.gpu to the runtime's GPU option (nvidia, auto, virgl, ...) and cua.on to a machine that has the GPU. Only the refusal is tested: no GPU host was available to verify a GPU Space end to end (evidence: AWS compat boxes are c8i CPU instances; the a real-Space test host Macs are not a runtime GPU option).

create_params.name: cloud
create_params.notes: A Modal cloud is not a Cua placement; ignored with a warning. Placement is the gateway's --on or experimental_options cua.on.

create_params.name: region
create_params.notes: Same as cloud.

create_params.name: cpu
create_params.notes: Rounded up to whole CPUs for the Space (the larger of a (request, limit) pair).

create_params.name: memory
create_params.notes: MiB of the Space (the larger of a pair).

create_params.name: runtime
create_params.notes: gvisor or vm becomes the Space's isolation kind (an explicit cua.kind wins); other values are InvalidError.

create_params.name: block_network
create_params.notes: A Space without outbound network.

create_params.name: outbound_cidr_allowlist
create_params.notes: UnimplementedError: no host-enforced allowlist (block-all or open only).

create_params.name: outbound_domain_allowlist
create_params.notes: UnimplementedError, as the CIDR allowlist.

create_params.name: _experimental_outbound_policy
create_params.notes: UnimplementedError: header replacement needs an egress proxy outside the Space.

create_params.name: inbound_cidr_allowlist
create_params.notes: UnimplementedError: tunnels do not filter by source address.

create_params.name: cidr_allowlist
create_params.notes: The deprecated alias of outbound_cidr_allowlist: UnimplementedError.

create_params.name: volumes
create_params.notes: Volume and CloudBucketMount mounts (see their rows).

create_params.name: pty
create_params.notes: The entrypoint runs on a PTY; stdout and stderr are merged.

create_params.name: pty_info
create_params.notes: The PTY's size and mode for the entrypoint.

create_params.name: encrypted_ports
create_params.notes: Ports 1-65535, each once; served under the TLS router.

create_params.name: h2_ports
create_params.notes: Encrypted ports whose TLS name negotiates h2 (a guest server speaking HTTP/2 without TLS, such as a gRPC server); ordinary encrypted ports negotiate http/1.1.

create_params.name: unencrypted_ports
create_params.notes: Loopback listeners (Tunnel.tcp_socket).

create_params.name: custom_domain
create_params.notes: UnimplementedError: tunnels are served under the gateway's own domain.

create_params.name: proxy
create_params.notes: UnimplementedError (ProxyGet).

create_params.name: include_oidc_identity_token
create_params.notes: UnimplementedError: tokens are issued by Modal's identity provider.

create_params.name: readiness_probe
create_params.notes: tcp and exec probes, polled by wait_until_ready.

create_params.name: verbose
create_params.notes: Client-side logging only.

create_params.name: experimental_options
create_params.notes: enable_exit_snapshot and the Cua options (cua.on, cua.kind, cua.cpus, cua.memory_mb, cua.gpu, cua.disk_gb) are honoured; any other option is UnimplementedError.

create_params.name: _experimental_enable_snapshot
create_params.notes: Allows _experimental_snapshot.

create_params.name: environment_name
create_params.notes: The Environment namespace.
